<!-- gate-reference:start — generated by `go run ./tools/sitecli` from the gate catalog and the checker's spec; edit those, not this block -->

No secret (key, token, credential) enters the history.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Command | `gitleaks git --no-banner --redact -v` |
| Confronts | `code` |
| Blocking by default — new project | yes |
| Blocking by default — existing project | yes |

## Declaring it

```yaml
gates:
  - name: no-secret-leaked
    on: [code]
    run: "gitleaks git --no-banner --redact -v"
```
